title: Death Guild
problem: On a debuff to an enemy, the code loops over your 6 party slots. For each living creature without Godforge 16 it adds the guild bonus again, compounding (e.g. +15% six times = ×2.31). It stops at the first creature that has Godforge 16 (that creature's Godforge bonus applies instead). The guild bonus clearly belongs outside the loop.
notes: Community claim: Debuff Potency bonus is applied once per creature in the party. Evidence: scr_CritAddCondition L295-L305: loop head @0x142019ea0, guild add @0x14201a226, jmp 0x142019ea0 @0x14201a29a (continue). Fix sketch: H: move the guild add out of the loop. Approximate S: change that jmp to 0x14201a493 (applies once, but stops the Godforge search early) Triage 2026-10-26: Guild Debuff Potency bonus compounds once per living party creature. Hook: apply it once outside the loop (S stopgap ends the Godforge search early). Batch R: not built. Applying the guild add once needs a per-call reset of the add (scr_CritAddCondition has 371 callers); the stopgap (exit the loop after the add) would end the Godforge 16 search early. Needs a function-entry reset or a loop-index test. Round-2 hook (A2): three call-free detours in scr_CritAddCondition's party loop: clear a flag at loop entry, set it after the guild add, skip later guild adds; the Godforge 16 search continues. In-game test: Death Guild with 6 living creatures: a debuff on an enemy gets the guild Debuff Potency bonus once (same potency as with 1 creature alive).

release_notes.intended: The guild's Debuff Potency bonus applies to debuffs on enemies.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the bonus was applied once for each living creature in the party, compounding.
release_notes.fix: Now it applies once per debuff.
